description: Set the number of columns inside a text frame (not the page grid): count (1 or more; the parameter is count, not column_count) and gutter_mm (Spaltenabstand; without it the frame keeps its current gutter – InDesign's own default for new frames is 1 pica = 4.233 mm). Returns frame_id, count and gutter_mm read back. Fails with invalid_state for anything but a text frame.

count.description: Number of columns inside the frame.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

gutter_mm.description: Gutter between the columns in mm. Without it the current gutter of the frame stays.

name: set_frame_columns
title: Columns inside a text frame
